title: Heidelberg Register for orofacial pain (heiPR register)
summary:
For many patients with pain and discomfort in the jaw and facial area, no dental problems can be identified as the cause. These complaints usually manifest as pain or restricted movement in the masticatory muscles or temporomandibular joints and are summarised under the term ‘temporomandibular disorders’ (TMDs, also known as CMDs). 
The aim of this study at Heidelberg University Hospital is to set up a prospective register for patients with orofacial pain. All participants will be examined and classified according to established diagnostic standards. The diagnosis includes an analysis of the pain symptoms as well as a structured survey to differentiate other possible causes. The collected data should help to improve diagnostic standards and assess the long-term effectiveness of conservative treatment methods.
conditions: Groups 1 to 6 of the International Classification of Orofacial Pain, 1st edition

interventions.name: All patients with orofacial pain who present to the Department of Prosthodontics at Heidelberg University Hospital in the consultation hours for masticatory dysfunction and facial pain as well as in follow-up appointments will be included in the register.
